testimonials.name: Rajesh Sharma
testimonials.title: Business Traveler
testimonials.text: Exceptional service and attention to detail. The hospitality at Grand Konark Ellora exceeded all my expectations. The location is perfect for exploring the heritage sites.

testimonials.name: Priya Desai
testimonials.title: Heritage Enthusiast
testimonials.text: A true luxury experience combined with cultural immersion. The staff's knowledge about local attractions was invaluable. Highly recommended for heritage travelers.

testimonials.name: Michael Johnson
testimonials.title: International Guest
testimonials.text: Outstanding! The blend of modern luxury and traditional charm is rare. Every detail was perfect, from the rooms to the dining experience.

testimonials.name: Anjali Patel
testimonials.title: Family Vacationer
testimonials.text: Perfect for families. The rooms are spacious, the amenities are great, and the staff is very child-friendly. We'll definitely return.

testimonials.name: David Chen
testimonials.title: Adventure Seeker
testimonials.text: The concierge team helped us plan an amazing itinerary. The hotel's attention to guest experience is unmatched in this region.
